##### Project general facts

Naya at District One is a premium residential development comprising three elegant towers offering a diverse selection of 1- to 4-bedroom apartments, lagoon villas, and 5-bedroom penthouses. Each residence is thoughtfully designed to combine sophisticated architecture with exceptional views of the Crystal Lagoon and Dubai skyline. The bespoke towers feature elegant lobbies with airy lofted ceilings, beautiful furnishings, and 24-hour security, creating a refined and welcoming arrival experience.

The development offers a luxurious waterfront lifestyle surrounded by lush landscaping and the spectacular Crystal Lagoon. Residents can enjoy some of the finest views in District One, with lagoon-facing apartments and villas creating a peaceful setting while remaining connected to the vibrant Dubai skyline. The diverse selection of residences makes Naya suitable for different family sizes, while spacious layouts provide ideal spaces for relaxation and entertaining.

The residences feature floor-to-ceiling windows that maximise natural light and showcase the stunning surroundings. Warm neutral tones create an elegant and versatile interior palette, complemented by refined flooring throughout the living, dining, master, and secondary bedroom areas, as well as the show kitchens. The kitchens are fitted with high-end built-in appliances, while the residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

At the edge of man-made crystal lagoon stands Naya at District One, a one-of-a-kind resort-inspired oasis. Part of the prestigious Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City, Naya at District One offers a lifestyle grounded in wellness along the shoreline of pristine waters. Located in the heart of Dubai, District One offers 45 million square feet of sophisticated space to live, work, dine, shop, discover, and play.

Nestled among stretches of white sand beaches, the development dedicates over 60% of its area to green spaces, with 8.4 kilometers of cycling and running tracks winding throughout. Featuring 14 kilometers of waterfront, bespoke mansions, villas, and elegant apartments, residents can literally walk, bike, drive, jog, paddle board or kayak to explore District One. A mere 4 kilometers from Downtown Dubai, Naya is only minutes from the Meydan Racecourse, 15 minutes to the renowned Burj al Arab, and 20 minutes to the Dubai International Airport. Despite being in the heart of this bustling metropolis, Naya at District One feels worlds away, wrapped in the greenery of nature and the clear blue of the lagoon.

At the heart of the verdant oasis of Mohammed Bin Rashid Al Maktoum City – Disctrict One is home to the 7 km stretch of Crystal Lagoon. Standing on the shores of man-made lagoon, Naya at District One residents enjoy an awe-inspiring beachfront right on their doorstep. Every home features stunning views of crystal clear water, making it the ultimate waterfront living experience in Dubai. A relaxing stroll along the pristine sands while meditating as a perfect opportunity for mindfulness and wellness.
